name: ServerAudit
short: Read-only Discord server audit of settings, roles, permissions and bots.
description: Generates a prioritized report of guild security settings, member and bot permissions, channel overrides, AutoMod and invites. Sends Markdown/JSON privately by DM. No changes are made.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores no persistent user data. On-demand role, channel, member/bot and safety-setting snapshots are generated in memory and sent as Discord direct messages only to the authorized requester. The cog retains no reports.
install_msg: Run [p]load serveraudit then [p]audit or [p]audit export. Reports are privately DM'd to the server owner or users with Manage Server; no changes made.
